burro init · create burro.toml, write the agent rules block, ignore .burro/

Usage: burro init [--agents-file path] [--print]

  --agents-file path    write the rules here, not into AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md
  --print               print the rules block and write nothing

Example
  burro init --agents-file docs/AGENTS.md

Exit codes  0 set up · 4 not a git repository or bad flags
